Why People Struggle

People don't struggle because they're broken.
They struggle because nobody taught them.

Most relationship pain comes not from bad luck — but from never having learned the core skills of healthy connection.

How attachment styles shape every relationship
How to set and hold real boundaries
How to communicate without losing yourself
How to regulate emotions under pressure
What healthy, secure connection actually feels like
Coach John Gagiu

The coach who
has lived it too

John Gagiu is a dating coach, former church minister, father of three and founder of The Connection Code. He holds a Master's degree in Psychology and is a Gottman Level 1 certified practitioner.

He has spent years helping people navigate heartbreak, attachment wounds, dating confusion and the quiet devastation of patterns that will not break — not from theory, but from a life that required him to understand these things in himself first.

The problem is rarely lack of effort. It is lack of understanding. That is exactly what The Connection Code was built to fix.
